metadata.description: Curated sources for LLM model adaptation: SFT, PEFT/LoRA/QLoRA, dataset formatting, distillation and compression, tokenizer diagnostics, plus provider lookup pages for current-fact checks.

standards_and_protocols.name: Build a Large Language Model (From Scratch) (Raschka, Manning 2024)

standards_and_protocols.relevance: Ch. 8 is the source for the hard-vs-soft distillation distinction, the closed-API/tokenizer blockers, and the point-in-time DGX Spark resource comparison in advanced-llm-patterns.md.

frameworks_and_infrastructure.name: The future of torchtune (deprecation notice, issue #2883)

post_training_and_rl.name: DPO: Direct Preference Optimization
post_training_and_rl.relevance: Foundational reference for DPO — preference optimization without a reward model or rollouts.

post_training_and_rl.name: SimPO: Simple Preference Optimization
post_training_and_rl.relevance: DPO variant without reference model; length-normalized margin reward.

post_training_and_rl.name: KTO: Model Alignment as Prospect Theoretic Optimization
post_training_and_rl.relevance: Preference optimization from binary (scalar) feedback rather than pairwise comparisons.

post_training_and_rl.name: ORPO: Monolithic Preference Optimization without Reference Model
post_training_and_rl.relevance: Single-stage SFT + alignment without reference model.

post_training_and_rl.name: DeepSeekMath (GRPO source)
post_training_and_rl.relevance: Primary reference introducing GRPO (Group Relative Policy Optimization) for RL with verifiable rewards.

post_training_and_rl.name: DeepSeek-R1 Technical Report
post_training_and_rl.relevance: Large-scale RLVR/GRPO application; important for understanding 2025-2026 RL post-training practice.

post_training_and_rl.name: TRL (Transformer Reinforcement Learning) Documentation
post_training_and_rl.relevance: Hugging Face library supporting DPO, KTO, GRPO, ORPO, SFT trainers; verify supported algorithms against current version.

post_training_and_rl.name: OpenRLHF
post_training_and_rl.relevance: Open-source RLHF framework supporting PPO, DPO, GRPO at large scale.

post_training_and_rl.name: GSPO (Group Sequence Policy Optimization)
post_training_and_rl.relevance: Qwen team (Zheng et al., 2025). GRPO-family RL method with sequence-level (not token-level) importance sampling; fixes routing-induced training collapse on MoE models. Production standard for large-scale MoE RL; used to train Qwen3. Verify arXiv ID before citing.

post_training_and_rl.name: Instruction Tuning With Loss Over Instructions (Shi et al., 2024)
post_training_and_rl.relevance: Cited as the contested counter-evidence to masking instruction tokens during SFT: reports conditions where NOT masking instructions benefits performance. Direction only.

post_training_and_rl.name: DoRA: Weight-Decomposed Low-Rank Adaptation
post_training_and_rl.relevance: Liu et al. (verified 2026-08-31). Decomposes weights into magnitude + direction, LoRA on the direction; peft use_dora=True. Source for the DoRA row in fine-tuning-recipes.md.

post_training_and_rl.name: A Rank Stabilization Scaling Factor for Fine-Tuning with LoRA (rsLoRA)
post_training_and_rl.relevance: Kalajdzievski (verified 2026-08-31). Replaces LoRA's alpha/r scaling with alpha/sqrt(r) so high-rank adapters keep learning. Source for the rank>=64 guidance.

post_training_and_rl.name: Few-Shot Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning is Better and Cheaper than In-Context Learning (IA3/T-Few)
post_training_and_rl.relevance: Liu et al. (verified 2026-08-31). IA3 scales activations by learned vectors; minimal per-task parameters. Source for the IA3 row.

post_training_and_rl.name: QLoRA: Efficient Finetuning of Quantized LLMs
post_training_and_rl.relevance: Dettmers et al. (verified 2026-08-31). NF4 4-bit base, double quantization, paged optimizers; LoRA adapters on top. Source for the QLoRA recipe details.

post_training_and_rl.name: LoRA Learns Less and Forgets Less
post_training_and_rl.relevance: Biderman et al. (verified 2026-08-31). LoRA can underperform full fine-tuning on hard target domains while forgetting less out-of-domain. Source for the when-full-FT escalation rule; direction only, no magnitudes quoted.

evaluation_and_observability.name: Braintrust Documentation

model_compression_and_distillation.name: Hinton, Vinyals & Dean — Distilling the Knowledge in a Neural Network
model_compression_and_distillation.relevance: Origin of logit/soft-label knowledge distillation; cited as the reference point for temperature-softened distribution matching.

model_compression_and_distillation.name: Gu et al. — MiniLLM: On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models
model_compression_and_distillation.relevance: Replaces forward KL with reverse KL for generative LLM distillation; cited for the mode-averaging failure mode of small students.

model_compression_and_distillation.name: Agarwal et al. — On-Policy Distillation of Language Models: Learning from Self-Generated Mistakes (GKD)
model_compression_and_distillation.relevance: Names and fixes the train/inference distribution mismatch in auto-regressive KD by training the student on its own generations with teacher feedback.

model_compression_and_distillation.name: Hsieh et al. — Distilling Step-by-Step
model_compression_and_distillation.relevance: Extracts LLM rationales as additional supervision in a multi-task setup; cited as the rationale-distillation variant.

model_compression_and_distillation.name: Sreenivas et al. — LLM Pruning and Distillation in Practice: The Minitron Approach
model_compression_and_distillation.relevance: Prune-then-distill recipe compressing Llama 3.1 8B and Mistral NeMo 12B; cited as the compression-first path and the depth-vs-width pruning comparison.

expert_panel_aug_2026.name: Compact Language Models via Pruning and Knowledge Distillation (Minitron, original)
expert_panel_aug_2026.relevance: Original Minitron paper behind the prune-then-distill path in Pattern 7; source of the '<3% of the original training data' and 'up to 40x fewer training tokens per model' retraining-budget figures now quoted verbatim.

expert_panel_aug_2026.name: PEFT — LoRA adapter conceptual guide (variants: rsLoRA, DoRA, PiSSA, LoRA+)
expert_panel_aug_2026.relevance: Live-verified source for the LoRA-variant table in fine-tuning-recipes.md: rsLoRA alpha/sqrt(r) 'stabilizes the adapters and increases the performance potential from using a higher r', PiSSA 'converges more rapidly than LoRA', LoRA+ 'up to 2x' speed and '1-2%' performance, DoRA magnitude/direction decomposition.

expert_panel_aug_2026.name: PEFT — Quantization guide (QLoRA config fields, VeRA/AdaLoRA/IA3 quantization support)
expert_panel_aug_2026.relevance: Source for the QLoRA three-dtype rule in Recipe 3: bnb_4bit_quant_type='nf4', bnb_4bit_use_double_quant=True (nested quantization of already-quantized weights), bnb_4bit_compute_dtype=torch.bfloat16, and target_modules='all-linear' as QLoRA-style training. Also confirms VeRA supports bitsandbytes quantization.

expert_panel_aug_2026.name: vLLM — LoRA adapters (multi-adapter serving)
expert_panel_aug_2026.relevance: Source for the multi-adapter serving note: 'Requests can specify the LoRA adapter as if it were any other model via the model request parameter', with concurrency governed by max_loras. Supersedes the Houlsby adapter-tuning hot-swap niche.

expert_panel_aug_2026.name: torchtune issue #2883 — [IMPORTANT] The future of torchtune
expert_panel_aug_2026.relevance: Dated basis (2025-07-15) for the torchtune framework-table cell: active development stopped in favour of a successor repo for end-to-end post-training at scale, with critical bug fixes and security patches continuing through 2025. Framed as migration, not abandonment.

expert_panel_aug_2026.name: GaLore: Memory-Efficient LLM Training by Gradient Low-Rank Projection
expert_panel_aug_2026.relevance: Cited as the middle option in the 'when full fine-tuning instead' escalation: memory-efficient FULL fine-tuning via low-rank gradient projection, distinct from PEFT adapter methods.

expert_panel_aug_2026.name: LoRA+: Efficient Low Rank Adaptation of Large Models
expert_panel_aug_2026.relevance: Paper behind the LoRA+ row in the LoRA-variants table (separate learning rates for the A and B matrices).
